title: Extreme Partner First™: Announcing the Next Evolution in Partnership
summary: Introducing Extreme Partner First™, a major update to our partner program and a new brand for our partner ecosystem reflecting our partnership philosophy.
body_markdown:
## Join the Extreme Partner First Program


To learn more about the Extreme Partner First Program and how to become an Extreme Partner, visit our[Partner Page](https://www.extremenetworks.com/partners) .


Once you join, here’s a sneak peek at what’s waiting for you:


- [Extreme Partner Portal](https://extremenetworks.webinfinity.com/explore/2188336) – Your central hub for deal registration, training, marketing resources, and community engagement.
- [Extreme Partner Demand Center](https://extremenetworks.webinfinity.com/content/1708850) – Access ready-to-launch campaigns and co-brandable assets to drive demand and accelerate pipeline.
- [Extreme Partner Pulse Podcast](https://extremenetworks.webinfinity.com/content/4210485) – Created for partners on the go! Tune in for insider insights, success stories, and strategies from featured guests.
- [Extreme Partner Sales AI Assistant](https://extremenetworks.webinfinity.com/content/4509277) – A game-changing sales acceleration tool that helps you qualify opportunities faster and close deals with confidence.
